An infidel spy sits with the companions on a journey and leaves; at the Prophet's order Salama chases and kills him and is given the spy's belongings.
Ibn Umar's horse and runaway slave, lost to the enemy and the Byzantines, are returned to him once the Muslims win, Khalid bin Al-Walid restoring them.
Horses bring reward and booty; Khosrau's and Caesar's treasures will be spent for Allah; booty, consumed by fire for an earlier prophet, is lawful now; Umar keeps conquered land undivided.
A Najd raiding party got eleven or twelve camels each and one extra, the Prophet giving some members extra shares; Abu Musa's shipmates from Ethiopia shared Khaibar's booty without fighting.
At Badr two Ansari youths kill Abu Jahl, his spoils going to Mu'adh bin Amr; at Hunain Abu Qatada gets the spoils of the pagan he killed.
The Prophet gives to some to hold them to Islam, reassures the Ansar over the Hawazin booty, gives to grabbing bedouins, and bears a charge of injustice like Moses.
Khaibar's booty gives a horseman three shares and a foot soldier one; Banu al-Muttalib, called one with Banu Hashim, get part of its fifth, but Abd Shams and Nawfal none.
Khaibar's booty: Abu Musa's late party get a share but Aban's none, a sheet stolen before division burns its taker, and Umar keeps conquered land undivided for all Muslims.
